scenarios.title: An effect without zone-specific text applies only to permanents

setup.notes: B has no other cards. Day of Judgment has no zone-specific text, so it affects only creatures on the battlefield.

decisions: A casts Day of Judgment, tapping four Plains.
Both players pass; Day of Judgment resolves.

variants.label: battlefield
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (on the battlefield) is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: graveyard
variants.delta: B's Grizzly Bears is in B's graveyard instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Day of Judgment resolves and destroys nothing; Grizzly Bears stays in B's graveyard.

variants.label: hand
variants.delta: B's Grizzly Bears is in B's hand instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Day of Judgment resolves and destroys nothing; Grizzly Bears stays in B's hand.

scenarios.title: An effect asking for more than is possible does as much as it can
decisions: A casts Mind Rot targeting B, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Mind Rot resolves.

variants.label: one-card
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves; B discards Grizzly Bears, the only card in B's hand, and B's hand is empty.

variants.label: two-cards
variants.delta: B's hand is Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves; B discards Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant, and both are in B's graveyard.

variants.label: empty-hand
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves and B discards nothing; nothing else happens.

scenarios.title: An as-though effect applies only to the stated action
decisions: Query: at A's beginning of combat with an empty stack, with A holding Divination and Island, can A cast Divination, tapping three Islands?
A has not played a land this turn.

variants.label: sorcery-cast
variants.expected: can_play is true for casting Divination at A's beginning of combat.

variants.label: no-orrery
variants.delta: Vedalken Orrery is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: can_play is false for Divination.

variants.label: land
variants.delta: The card asked about is Island, played from hand, instead of casting Divination.
variants.expected: can_play is false for playing Island at A's beginning of combat, with Vedalken Orrery on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Two as-though effects both apply to the same action
decisions: It is B's upkeep. A casts Shaman's Trance, tapping three Mountains, and it resolves.
A casts Firebolt from B's graveyard for its flashback cost {4}{R}, tapping five Mountains, targeting B.
Both players pass; Firebolt resolves.

variants.label: both
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt from B's graveyard for its flashback cost at B's upkeep is legal. Firebolt deals 2 damage to B (life 18) and is exiled.

variants.label: no-orrery
variants.delta: Vedalken Orrery is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt from B's graveyard at B's upkeep is illegal. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: no-trance
variants.delta: A does not cast Shaman's Trance first.
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt from B's graveyard is illegal. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Shaman's Trance is implemented as a keyword granted to its controller. Firebolt is cast with its flashback cost from the opponent's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Spending mana as though it were any color changes how a cost is paid, not the cost
decisions: Query: can A cast Coral Merfolk ({1}{U}) with its two untapped Mountains?

variants.label: orrery
variants.expected: can_play is true for Coral Merfolk paid with {R}{R} from the two Mountains; its cost stays {1}{U}.

variants.label: no-orrery
variants.delta: Chromatic Orrery is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: can_play is false for Coral Merfolk.

scenarios.forge_notes: Chromatic Orrery can also tap for {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}; that mana is not used here.

scenarios.title: Mana spent as though it were another color is still the mana actually spent
decisions: A casts Firespout ({2}{R/G}), paying {R/G} with an Island (blue mana spent as though it were red) and {2} with two more Islands. The Mountain stays untapped.
Both players pass; Firespout resolves.

variants.label: islands
variants.expected: Firespout resolves and deals no damage; Grizzly Bears is undamaged and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: mountain
variants.delta: A pays {R/G} with the Mountain instead of an Island, and the two generic with Islands.
variants.expected: Firespout deals 3 damage to each creature without flying; Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Firespout's cost is a hybrid {R/G}; whether Forge lets blue mana pay it through Chromatic Orrery's ManaConvert depends on the payment prompt.

scenarios.title: A damage-source shield applies to the next damage from the chosen source, whatever its kind

setup.notes: Neither red creature is summoning sick. A has no cards in hand.

decisions: B activates Prodigal Pyromancer's ability ({T}) targeting A.
B passes priority; A activates Circle of Protection: Red, paying {1} by tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Circle of Protection's ability resolves and A chooses Prodigal Pyromancer as the red source.
Both players pass; Prodigal Pyromancer's ability resolves.

variants.label: chosen
variants.expected: The 1 damage from Prodigal Pyromancer (an ability, not combat damage) is prevented; A's life stays 20.

variants.label: other-source
variants.delta: A chooses Raging Goblin as the red source instead.
variants.expected: The 1 damage from Prodigal Pyromancer is dealt; A's life is 19. The shield for Raging Goblin is not used.

scenarios.title: A shield on a permanent spell applies to the permanent it becomes

setup.notes: Prodigal Pyromancer is a red source on the battlefield and is not used by B this turn.

decisions: B casts Raging Goblin, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; A activates Circle of Protection: Red, paying {1} by tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Circle of Protection's ability resolves and A chooses the Raging Goblin spell as the red source.
Both players pass; Raging Goblin resolves.
B moves to combat and attacks A with Raging Goblin (haste). A declares no blockers.

variants.label: spell-chosen
variants.expected: The 1 combat damage dealt by the Raging Goblin permanent is prevented; A's life stays 20.

variants.label: other-source
variants.delta: A chooses Prodigal Pyromancer as the red source instead of the Raging Goblin spell.
variants.expected: Raging Goblin deals 1 combat damage to A; A's life is 19.

scenarios.forge_notes: The shield tracks the chosen card by identity; whether Forge keeps it across the spell becoming a permanent should be checked.

scenarios.title: A source-property shield rechecks the source when the damage would be dealt

setup.notes: Prodigal Pyromancer is not summoning sick. Alchor's Tomb is untapped.

decisions: B activates Prodigal Pyromancer's ability ({T}) targeting A.
B passes priority; A activates Circle of Protection: Red, paying {1} by tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Circle of Protection's ability resolves and A chooses Prodigal Pyromancer as the red source.
B, who has priority, activates Alchor's Tomb ({2},{T}) targeting Prodigal Pyromancer and chooses blue.
Both players pass; Alchor's Tomb's ability resolves.
Both players pass; Prodigal Pyromancer's ability resolves.

variants.label: recoloured
variants.expected: Prodigal Pyromancer is blue when it would deal damage, so the shield does not apply: A takes 1 damage (life 19). The shield is not used up.

variants.label: still-red
variants.delta: B does not activate Alchor's Tomb.
variants.expected: Prodigal Pyromancer is still red; its 1 damage is prevented and A's life stays 20. The shield is used up.

scenarios.title: A static damage replacement keyed to a source property also applies to sources outside the battlefield
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: red-spell
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 5 damage to B (3 plus 2 from Torbran, Thane of Red Fell); B's life is 15.

variants.label: green-spell
variants.delta: A casts Hornet Sting (green) targeting B, tapping Forest, instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Hornet Sting deals 1 damage to B; B's life is 19.
